hypotheses.title: XSEC PIT V5 causal cross-sectional replication
hypotheses.reopen_when: Reopen only when causal histories for every delisted and active Bybit USDT linear contract are materialized, their point-in-time membership is independently checked, and a four-phase conveyor adapter hashes that frozen universe; current-137 substitution is prohibited.

preregistration.hypothesis: A point-in-time cross-sectional crypto signal may retain diagnostic value only when evaluated on the complete causal eligible universe.
preregistration.universe: The active and delisted Bybit USDT linear perpetual contracts with membership known at each UTC daily decision timestamp.
preregistration.signal: The frozen XSEC PIT V5 ranking defined by the cited causal contract and preregistration.
preregistration.entry: Enter only at the next UTC daily open after a fully known ranking event.
preregistration.exit: Exit at the next frozen UTC daily rebalance or risk rule in the causal contract without post-event revision.
preregistration.costs: Apply turnover, exact funding, and preregistered base and stress basis-point costs to every eligible transaction.
preregistration.control: Compare against a same-date randomized ranking and a passive universe-matched crypto baseline.
preregistration.stress: Recompute under delayed fills, higher basis-point costs, funding stress, and membership-history omissions flagged as failures rather than imputed.
preregistration.concentration: Report symbol, month, side, and survivor concentration before any diagnostic conclusion.
preregistration.death_criteria: Reject the hypothesis if causal replay fails its preregistered control or stress gate, or if complete causal membership cannot be proven.
preregistration.acceptance_gate: Only four valid conveyor phase receipts on frozen causal data may produce PASS_DIAGNOSTIC; no result authorizes promotion.
